title: Ammopiptanthus nanus (M. Pop.) Cheng f. stem ethanolic extract ameliorates rheumatoid arthritis by inhibiting PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB pathway-mediated macrophage infiltration.
authors: Yao, Yuan; Wang, Jiaye; Zhang, Hongjuan; Peng, Tao; Sun, Yanpei; Zhang, Ruili; Meng, Xiang; Lu, Xu; Gao, Yankun; Jin, Yang; Zhang, Yu; Chen, Lina
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物提取物治疗类风湿关节炎的机制，涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Ammopiptanthus nanus (M. Pop.) Cheng f. (A. nanus), a traditional Kirgiz medicinal plant, its stem has shown potential in treating rheumatoid arthritis (RA) in China, either through oral medication or by topical application directly to the affected joints, but its underlying mechanism of action remains unexplored. AIM OF THE STUDY: The purpose of this study is to elucidate pharmacological mechanism of A. nanus in ameliorating RA using a comprehensive approach that combines network pharmacology, molecular docking and experimental evaluations. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Firstly, the major constituents of A. nanus stem ethanolic extract were identified and quantified by High-Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC). Disease target data from Gene Cards database was then used to define RA-associated targets. A protein-protein interaction (PPI) network was created via STRING database. The DAVID database powered gene ontology (GO) function and kyoto encyclopedia of genes and genomes (KEGG) pathway enrichment analysis to gain functional insights. In vitro, RAW264.7 cells were treated with A. nanus to investigate the roles of target proteins and pathways during lipopolysaccharide (LPS) - induced inflammation. Immunofluorescence assays were performed to assess the effects of A. nanus on macrophage infiltration. The key targets and signalling pathways were validated using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR), molecular docking, immunohistochemical analysis, western blotting and immunofluorescence. Finally, the therapeutic potential of A. nanus in RA was evaluated in a carrageenan-induced rat model. RESULTS: Network analysis identified 31 potential targets of A. nanus associated with RA, including 10 hub targets. KEGG analysis highlighted the involvement of PI3K/AKT signaling pathway. In vivo experiments demonstrated that A. nanus treatment significantly protected against carrageenan-induced inflammatory paw tissue and attenuated macrophage infiltration. Both in vivo and in vitro experiments confirmed that A. nanus significantly downregulated the protein expression of COX-2, iNOS and IL-1beta, and inhibited PI3K/AKT/NFkappaB pathway, which are closely linked to RA. Furthermore, molecular docking and cellular thermal shift assay revealed that licoflavanone showed a strong binding affinity with key targets. CONCLUSION: In summary, this study provides the first evidence of the potent anti-inflammatory activity of A. nanus in experimental RA. The mechanism of action appears to involve inactivation of the PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB pathway-mediated macrophage infiltration. These findings indicate that A. nanus has significant potential as a therapeutic potential agent for RA treatment and offer novel insights for future research and drug development in this field.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：矮沙冬青（Ammopiptanthus nanus (M. Pop.) Cheng f.，简称A. nanus）是一种传统的柯尔克孜族药用植物，其茎在中国已被证明具有治疗类风湿关节炎（RA）的潜力，可通过口服或直接外敷于受累关节的方式使用，但其潜在的作用机制尚未被探索。研究目的：本研究旨在利用网络药理学、分子对接和实验评估相结合的综合方法，阐明A. nanus改善RA的药理机制。材料与方法：首先，通过高效液相色谱法（HPLC）鉴定并定量了A. nanus茎乙醇提取物的主要成分。随后，利用Gene Cards数据库中的疾病靶点数据确定RA相关靶点。通过STRING数据库构建了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络。利用DAVID数据库进行基因本体论（GO）功能和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路富集分析，以获得功能见解。在体外实验中，用A. nanus处理RAW264.7细胞，以研究靶蛋白和通路在脂多糖（LPS）诱导炎症过程中的作用。采用免疫荧光实验评估A. nanus对巨噬细胞浸润的影响。使用酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）、实时定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）、分子对接、免疫组织化学分析、蛋白质印迹和免疫荧光验证了关键靶点和信号通路。最后，在角叉菜胶诱导的大鼠模型中评估了A. nanus治疗RA的潜力。结果：网络分析确定了A. nanus与RA相关的31个潜在靶点，包括10个枢纽靶点。KEGG分析强调了PI3K/AKT信号通路的参与。体内实验表明，A. nanus治疗显著保护了角叉菜胶诱导的炎症足部组织，并减弱了巨噬细胞浸润。体内和体外实验均证实，A. nanus显著下调了COX-2、iNOS和IL-1β的蛋白表达，并抑制了与RA密切相关的PI3K/AKT/NF-κB通路。此外，分子对接和细胞热位移实验揭示，甘草黄酮（licoflavanone）与关键靶点表现出强结合亲和力。结论：总之，本研究首次提供了A. nanus在实验性RA中具有强效抗炎活性的证据。其作用机制似乎涉及PI3K/AKT/NF-κB通路介导的巨噬细胞浸润的失活。这些发现表明，A. nanus作为RA治疗药物具有显著潜力，并为该领域的未来研究和药物开发提供了新的见解。
